description: Build frontend admin reels page at /admin/reels following existing admin page patterns from products page
steps: Create frontend/app/admin/reels/page.tsx as a client component following the structure of products/page.tsx
Add reel-related API client functions to frontend/lib/api-client.ts: api.reels() for listing and api.createReel/updateReel/deleteReel for CRUD operations
Add TypeScript interfaces for Reel and AdminReel types in api-client.ts following existing AdminCatalogueProduct pattern
Implement reels list view with search, filtering, and table display showing title, video thumbnail, linked product, position, status, and actions
Add useApiResource hook integration with demo fallback data for reels listing
Implement create/edit reel form with fields for title, description, video URL, thumbnail URL, product selection dropdown, position, and active status
Add proper form validation and error handling following existing admin page patterns
Include delete/archive functionality with confirmation dialog following products page pattern
acceptance_criteria: Reels admin page renders without errors and shows consistent styling with other admin pages
Search and filtering functionality works correctly with live API data
Create/edit forms properly validate inputs and submit to backend API
Delete operations show confirmation and properly call backend API
Page gracefully falls back to demo data when API is not configured
All TypeScript interfaces compile without errors
verification: Run 'npm run build' in frontend directory to verify TypeScript compilation
Navigate to /admin/reels in browser and verify page loads and displays demo data
Test CRUD operations through the UI when connected to live backend API
findings:
Successfully implemented complete frontend admin reels page. Created AdminReel and ReelInput TypeScript interfaces following existing patterns. Added comprehensive API client functions for all CRUD operations. Built full-featured admin page with search, filtering, create/edit modals, form validation, and proper error handling. Includes demo data fallback and follows established admin UI styling. All TypeScript compilation successful. Ready for integration with backend API.

🔗 INTEGRATION VERIFIED: Complete frontend integration testing confirms:
- Admin page exists at /admin/reels with proper routing and metadata
- ReelsView component implements full CRUD interface with search/filtering
- API client functions (reels, createReel, updateReel, deleteReel) properly defined
- TypeScript interfaces (AdminReel, ReelInput) provide type safety
- Form validation prevents submission of incomplete data
- Demo data provides fallback when API unavailable
- Error handling displays user-friendly messages
- UI follows established admin design patterns and styling
- Build system compiles successfully without TypeScript errors
